All slimes!]])}} |legacy_speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |legacy_defense = {{Defense}}20% |legacy_hidden = No |legacy_fly = No |legacy_ghost = No |legacy_lead = No |legacy_immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Acid Bath}}''' - Creates an acidic puddle upon death, which rapidly heals any enemy that is walking through it. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Super Toxic''' is a large tanky enemy that appears in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. It has a high amount of health and an average speed. It has one ability where upon death, it creates an acidic puddle that rapidly heals any enemy that walks through it. It also has the [[Stun Immunity]], meaning that the [[Warden]] and [[Electroshocker]] can only slow it down instead of stunning it and prevents it from being knocked back, [[Freeze Immunity]], preventing it from being frozen or chilled and [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]], making it turn into a [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] on death. The '''Super Toxic''' replaces the [[Fallen Hero]] in [[Oops! All slimes!]] challenge. The '''Super Toxic''' used to be spawned by the [[Nuclear Monster]]. It also could have been spawned from the [[Mystery Boss]] wave 38 onwards in [[Polluted Wasteland II]]. ==Appearance== The '''Super Toxic''' is a large humanoid with a waist and lower arms in its rig. It has glowing light green skin and a black torso, waist and legs. It has corrugated metal shoulder-pads and grey metal neck-guards next to its head, both of which are covered in blood. It has a canister on its back, which is filled with acid. Green veins can be seen on its body and tumors can be seen on its head. It also emits green particles and pulses from its torso. ==Mutation== ===Nuclear=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto" ! colspan="2" |Mutation |- !Percentage !Increase |- |5% |4,250 |- !Wave !Health |- |22 |89,250 |- |23 |93,500 |- |24 |97,750 |- |25 |102,000 |} ===Oops! All slimes!=== {| class="tds-table align-center mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" style="width: 300px; margin: 0 auto;" ! colspan="2" |[[Mutation]] |- !Percentage !Increase |- |8% |400 |- !Wave !Health |- |40 |5,400 |} ==Strategy== *Towers with high DPS such as the [[Accelerator]], [[Ranger]], [[Turret]] or the [[Engineer]] are recommended to be used against this enemy. **You can also use support towers such as the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to buff these towers. *Be careful of the '''Super Toxic's''' ''Acid Bath'' ability as it can rapidly heal other enemies, making it a much bigger threat when there are large groups of enemies. **This ability also works on the [[Nuclear Monster]]. **If it proves problematic, this ability can be cancelled out by the [[Hacker]]'s enemy conversion, as that also cancels abilities that activate on death. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSuperToxic.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- ☢️ NUCLEAR Update!☢️|'''Super Toxic''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexSuperToxic.png|'''Super Toxic''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Super Toxic''' despite being an acidic enemy, does not have any immunity to the [[Toxic Gunner]]. ==Update History== *'''29 July 2022''' - [[v1.3.0]] **'''Super Toxic''' added. *'''7 April 2023''' - [[v1.7.0]] **[[Stun Immunity]] added. *'''23 June 2024''' - [[v1.25.0|v1.25.1]] **{{Bug}} Regenerated health now generates cash. *'''19 July 2024''' - [[v1.26.0]] **Health decreased from 12,000 to 5,000 in [[Oops! All slimes!]]. *'''19 February 2025''' - [[v1.54.0]] **Modern version added. ***None of the changes are applied to the legacy version. **Health increased from 12,000 to 40,000. **Speed decreased from Above Average (3.5) to Average (3). **Defense decreased from 20% to 15%. **Now gives {{Money|4,500}} every 10% health lost. **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. **[[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]] added. **{{Bug}} Appears twice in the [[Index]], one of them not loading in any model for the preview. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **{{Bug}} No longer creates acid puddles on death, but still heals enemies. *'''22 April 2026''' - [[v1.89.0]] **Health increased from 40,000 to 85,000. **Size increased. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **{{Bugfix}} No longer appears twice in the [[Index]]. ==Notes== {{PollutedWasteland|[[Abomination]]|Wave 20|Super Toxic|Wave 21|[[Warden (Modern Enemy)|Warden]]|Wave 22}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
